name: Bjørn Halvorsen
bio:
Bjørn's journey into motorsport began later in life, after a successful career as a mechanical engineer in the oil industry. The thrill of precision and optimization drew him in, leading him to pursue a second career in racing. He brings a meticulous and detail-oriented approach to performance engineering, focusing on data analysis and identifying marginal gains. While new to the paddock, his rigorous approach and relentless pursuit of improvement make him a valuable asset to any team willing to invest in his development. He believes the key to car performance is understanding every single interaction between the vehicle and the track.

Bjørn's perfectionist tendencies often lead him down rabbit holes of data, but his creative streak allows him to devise unconventional solutions to complex problems. He's eager to learn from the best and contribute his unique perspective to a winning formula. He is currently seeking a team that values a thorough, data-driven approach to performance enhancement, and he is willing to put in the extra hours to achieve peak performance.

physical.description: Bjørn is of average height with a slightly stocky build, reflecting his dedication to his work more than the gym.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with calculations.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on using metric units for everything, even when others are using imperial.
